title: How Smart Contracts Solve the Gap Problem | Sergey Nazarov on Visa’s Tokenized Podcast
description:
On Visa's Tokenized podcast, Chainlink Co-Founder Sergey Nazarov explains how smart contracts reduce fraud, minimize errors, and solve the gap problem.

Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi. 

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

✅ Subscribe and turn notifications on: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnjkrlqaWEBSnKZQ71gdyFA?sub_confirmation=1

Learn more about Chainlink:

Website: https://chain.link
Docs: https://docs.chain.link
Twitter: https://twitter.com/chainlink

#Chainlink #crypto #blockchain

asr.full_text: Yeah, I think it's exciting. MasterCard's 3.4 billion users being able to buy assets directly from on-chain systems like DEXs, I think is really a big deal because it's what we've been waiting for in the crypto industry and what we've been talking about at Chainlink for some time is that if you can get the traditional worlds users to interact with crypto in a frictionless, efficient, secure risk-managed way, then you can get many more users from the traditional world than you can get from just from people having wallets and from people kind of doing Crypto stuff. So I think that this was the starting point and the basis of our work together with you. Would you say that's right? That is absolutely correct. You know, look, if there are others in the ecosystem that need to enable everyone to have a cloud ecosystem, and the basis of our work together with you. Would you say that's right? That is absolutely correct. And look, if there are others in the ecosystem that need to enable this, and we have partners here today like Shif4, And Swapper, and so on. By the end of the day, all of that, the ecosystem partners need two essential things. One is obviously the consumer with the card who would be able to spend on the MasterCard Network completing that authorization. But that need to be kind of coordinated and ensured that the opposite side of that, which is the asset delivery part, purchase part who is happening with equal security, and that's where you guys come in, and I thought that partnership was perfect alignment in terms of making sure that we provide seamless connectivity between on-chain Asset Exchange and off-chain transactions, in this case, off-chain coming from Mastercard and on-chain coming from any supported blockchain coordinated through you guys.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is presented as a branded podcast discussion explaining smart contracts, tokenization, and blockchain infrastructure rather than making a direct offer to viewers. The speakers discuss Mastercard transactions, on-chain asset exchanges, and ecosystem coordination, while the links are described as ordinary subscription and informational website links. The available evidence does not establish deceptive conduct, a promised return, a required payment, or a transaction outcome.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central subject is how payment authorization, asset delivery and on-chain exchange would work together, fitting a technology and operational discussion.
